docs.text:
name: ContentIdentifierType
description: Specifies the type of a content identifier.
from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/spdx
rank: 1000
enum_uri: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/ContentIdentifierType
permissible_values:
  gitoid:
    text: gitoid
    description: '[Gitoid](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/prov/gitoid),
      stands for [Git Object ID](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Internals-Git-Objects).
      A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent
      either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types)
      for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier)
      for the software artifact''s associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest);
      this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact,
      and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated
      on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded
      in the SPDX 3.0 SoftwareArtifact''s contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated
      on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded
      in the SPDX 3.0 Element''s externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/),
      a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).'
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/ContentIdentifierType/gitoid
  swhid:
    text: swhid
    description: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital
      artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits,
      and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of
      the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/specification/v1.1/4.Syntax)
      (ISO/IEC DIS 18670). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/ContentIdentifierType/swhid

name: DatasetAvailabilityType
description: Availability of dataset.
from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/spdx
rank: 1000
enum_uri: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetAvailabilityType
permissible_values:
  clickthrough:
    text: clickthrough
    description: the dataset is not publicly available and can only be accessed after
      affirmatively accepting terms on a clickthrough webpage.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetAvailabilityType/clickthrough
  directDownload:
    text: directDownload
    description: the dataset is publicly available and can be downloaded directly.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetAvailabilityType/directDownload
  query:
    text: query
    description: the dataset is publicly available, but not all at once, and can only
      be accessed through queries which return parts of the dataset.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetAvailabilityType/query
  registration:
    text: registration
    description: the dataset is not publicly available and an email registration is
      required before accessing the dataset, although without an affirmative acceptance
      of terms.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetAvailabilityType/registration
  scrapingScript:
    text: scrapingScript
    description: the dataset provider is not making available the underlying data
      and the dataset must be reassembled, typically using the provided script for
      scraping the data.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetAvailabilityType/scrapingScript

docs.text: Value Meaning Description audio https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/audio data is audio based, such as a collection of music from the 80s categorical https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/categorical data that is classified into a discrete number of categories, such as the eye... graph https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/graph data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each othe... image https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/image data is a collection of images such as pictures of animals noAssertion https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/noAssertion data type is not known numeric https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/numeric data consists only of numeric entries other https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/other data is of a type not included in this list sensor https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/sensor data is recorded from a physical sensor, such as a thermometer reading or bio... structured https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/structured data is stored in tabular format or retrieved from a relational database syntactic https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/syntactic data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such as a parse... text https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/text data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, Wikipedia article (withou... timeseries https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/timeseries data is recorded in an ordered sequence of timestamped entries, such as the p... timestamp https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/timestamp data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered... video https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/video data is video based, such as a collection of movie clips featuring Tom Hanks

name: DatasetType
description: Enumeration of dataset types.

- 'Open/extensible enum: slots using this type allow any string via any_of.'

rank: 1000

permissible_values:
  audio:
    text: audio
    description: data is audio based, such as a collection of music from the 80s.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/audio
  categorical:
    text: categorical
    description: data that is classified into a discrete number of categories, such
      as the eye color of a population of people.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/categorical
  graph:
    text: graph
    description: data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related
      to each other through edges, such a social network of friends.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/graph
  image:
    text: image
    description: data is a collection of images such as pictures of animals.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/image
  noAssertion:
    text: noAssertion
    description: data type is not known.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/noAssertion
  numeric:
    text: numeric
    description: data consists only of numeric entries.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/numeric
  other:
    text: other
    description: data is of a type not included in this list.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/other
  sensor:
    text: sensor
    description: data is recorded from a physical sensor, such as a thermometer reading
      or biometric device.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/sensor
  structured:
    text: structured
    description: data is stored in tabular format or retrieved from a relational database.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/structured
  syntactic:
    text: syntactic
    description: data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such
      as a parse tree used for natural language processing.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/syntactic
  text:
    text: text
    description: data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, Wikipedia article
      (without images), or transcript.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/text
  timeseries:
    text: timeseries
    description: data is recorded in an ordered sequence of timestamped entries, such
      as the price of a stock over the course of a day.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/timeseries
  timestamp:
    text: timestamp
    description: data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily
      ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/timestamp
  video:
    text: video
    description: data is video based, such as a collection of movie clips featuring
      Tom Hanks.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Dataset/DatasetType/video

docs.text:
name: ExternalIdentifierType
description: Specifies the type of an external identifier.
notes:
- 'Open/extensible enum: slots using this type allow any string via any_of.'
from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/spdx
rank: 1000
enum_uri: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType
permissible_values:
  cpe22:
    text: cpe22
    description: '[Common Platform Enumeration Specification 2.2](https://cpe.mitre.org/files/cpe-specification_2.2.pdf)'
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType/cpe22
  cpe23:
    text: cpe23
    description: '[Common Platform Enumeration: Naming Specification Version 2.3](https://csrc.nist.gov/publications/detail/nistir/7695/final)'
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType/cpe23
  cve:
    text: cve
    description: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifiers, an identifier for
      a specific software flaw defined within the official CVE Dictionary and that
      conforms to the [CVE specification](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/cve_id).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType/cve
  email:
    text: email
    description: Email address, as defined in [RFC 3696](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3986/)
      Section 3.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType/email
  gitoid:
    text: gitoid
    description: '[Gitoid](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/prov/gitoid),
      stands for [Git Object ID](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Internals-Git-Objects).
      A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent
      either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types)
      for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier)
      for the software artifact''s associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest);
      this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact,
      and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated
      on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded
      in the SPDX 3.0 SoftwareArtifact''s contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated
      on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded
      in the SPDX 3.0 Element''s externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/),
      a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).'
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType/gitoid
  other:
    text: other
    description: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType/other
  packageUrl:
    text: packageUrl
    description: Package URL, as defined in the corresponding [Annex](../../../annexes/pkg-url-specification.md)
      of this specification.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType/packageUrl
  securityOther:
    text: securityOther
    description: Used when there is a security related identifier of unspecified type.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType/securityOther
  swhid:
    text: swhid
    description: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital
      artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits,
      and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of
      the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/specification/v1.1/4.Syntax)
      (ISO/IEC DIS 18670). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType/swhid
  swid:
    text: swid
    description: Concise Software Identification (CoSWID) tag, as defined in [RFC
      9393](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9393/) Section 2.3.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType/swid
  urlScheme:
    text: urlScheme
    description: '[Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) Schemes](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/uri-schemes.xhtml).
      The scheme used in order to locate a resource.'
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalIdentifierType/urlScheme

docs.text:
name: ExternalRefType
description: Specifies the type of an external reference.
notes:
- 'Open/extensible enum: slots using this type allow any string via any_of.'
from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/spdx
rank: 1000
enum_uri: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType
permissible_values:
  altDownloadLocation:
    text: altDownloadLocation
    description: A reference to an alternative download location.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/altDownloadLocation
  altWebPage:
    text: altWebPage
    description: A reference to an alternative web page.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/altWebPage
  binaryArtifact:
    text: binaryArtifact
    description: A reference to binary artifacts related to a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/binaryArtifact
  bower:
    text: bower
    description: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks
      like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/bower
  buildMeta:
    text: buildMeta
    description: A reference build metadata related to a published package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/buildMeta
  buildSystem:
    text: buildSystem
    description: A reference build system used to create or publish the package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/buildSystem
  certificationReport:
    text: certificationReport
    description: A reference to a certification report for a package from an accredited/independent
      body.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/certificationReport
  chat:
    text: chat
    description: A reference to the instant messaging system used by the maintainer
      for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/chat
  componentAnalysisReport:
    text: componentAnalysisReport
    description: A reference to a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) report.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/componentAnalysisReport
  cwe:
    text: cwe
    description: '[Common Weakness Enumeration](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/common_weakness_enumeration).
      A reference to a source of software flaw defined within the official [CWE List](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/)
      that conforms to the [CWE specification](https://cwe.mitre.org/).'
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/cwe
  documentation:
    text: documentation
    description: A reference to the documentation for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/documentation
  dynamicAnalysisReport:
    text: dynamicAnalysisReport
    description: A reference to a dynamic analysis report for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/dynamicAnalysisReport
  eolNotice:
    text: eolNotice
    description: A reference to the End Of Sale (EOS) and/or End Of Life (EOL) information
      related to a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/eolNotice
  exportControlAssessment:
    text: exportControlAssessment
    description: A reference to a export control assessment for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/exportControlAssessment
  funding:
    text: funding
    description: A reference to funding information related to a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/funding
  issueTracker:
    text: issueTracker
    description: A reference to the issue tracker for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/issueTracker
  license:
    text: license
    description: A reference to additional license information related to an artifact.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/license
  mailingList:
    text: mailingList
    description: A reference to the mailing list used by the maintainer for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/mailingList
  mavenCentral:
    text: mavenCentral
    description: A reference to a Maven repository artifact. The artifact locator
      format is defined in the [Maven documentation](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-naming-conventions.html)
      and looks like `groupId:artifactId[:version]`.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/mavenCentral
  metrics:
    text: metrics
    description: A reference to metrics related to package such as OpenSSF scorecards.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/metrics
  npm:
    text: npm
    description: A reference to an npm package. The package locator format is defined
      in the [npm documentation](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/package-json)
      and looks like `package@version`.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/npm
  nuget:
    text: nuget
    description: A reference to a NuGet package. The package locator format is defined
      in the [NuGet documentation](https://docs.nuget.org) and looks like `package/version`.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/nuget
  other:
    text: other
    description: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/other
  privacyAssessment:
    text: privacyAssessment
    description: A reference to a privacy assessment for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/privacyAssessment
  productMetadata:
    text: productMetadata
    description: A reference to additional product metadata such as reference within
      organization's product catalog.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/productMetadata
  purchaseOrder:
    text: purchaseOrder
    description: A reference to a purchase order for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/purchaseOrder
  qualityAssessmentReport:
    text: qualityAssessmentReport
    description: A reference to a quality assessment for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/qualityAssessmentReport
  releaseHistory:
    text: releaseHistory
    description: A reference to a published list of releases for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/releaseHistory
  releaseNotes:
    text: releaseNotes
    description: A reference to the release notes for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/releaseNotes
  riskAssessment:
    text: riskAssessment
    description: A reference to a risk assessment for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/riskAssessment
  runtimeAnalysisReport:
    text: runtimeAnalysisReport
    description: A reference to a runtime analysis report for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/runtimeAnalysisReport
  secureSoftwareAttestation:
    text: secureSoftwareAttestation
    description: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed
      using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development
      Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or
      [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/secureSoftwareAttestation
  securityAdversaryModel:
    text: securityAdversaryModel
    description: A reference to the security adversary model for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/securityAdversaryModel
  securityAdvisory:
    text: securityAdvisory
    description: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory as defined
      per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect
      one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/securityAdvisory
  securityFix:
    text: securityFix
    description: A reference to the patch or source code that fixes a vulnerability.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/securityFix
  securityOther:
    text: securityOther
    description: A reference to related security information of unspecified type.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/securityOther
  securityPenTestReport:
    text: securityPenTestReport
    description: A reference to a [penetration test](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penetration_test)
      report for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/securityPenTestReport
  securityPolicy:
    text: securityPolicy
    description: A reference to instructions for reporting newly discovered security
      vulnerabilities for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/securityPolicy
  securityThreatModel:
    text: securityThreatModel
    description: A reference the [security threat model](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Threat_model)
      for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/securityThreatModel
  socialMedia:
    text: socialMedia
    description: A reference to a social media channel for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/socialMedia
  sourceArtifact:
    text: sourceArtifact
    description: A reference to an artifact containing the sources for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/sourceArtifact
  staticAnalysisReport:
    text: staticAnalysisReport
    description: A reference to a static analysis report for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/staticAnalysisReport
  support:
    text: support
    description: A reference to the software support channel or other support information
      for a package.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/support
  vcs:
    text: vcs
    description: A reference to a version control system related to a software artifact.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/vcs
  vulnerabilityDisclosureReport:
    text: vulnerabilityDisclosureReport
    description: A reference to a Vulnerability Disclosure Report (VDR) which provides
      the software supplier's analysis and findings describing the impact (or lack
      of impact) that reported vulnerabilities have on packages or products in the
      supplier's SBOM as defined in [NIST SP 800-161 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk
      Management Practices for Systems and Organizations](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/161/r1/final).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/vulnerabilityDisclosureReport
  vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment:
    text: vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment
    description: A reference to a Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) statement
      which provides information on whether a product is impacted by a specific vulnerability
      in an included package and, if affected, whether there are actions recommended
      to remediate. See also [NTIA VEX one-page summary](https://ntia.gov/files/ntia/publications/vex_one-page_summary.pdf).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/ExternalRefType/vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment

docs.text:
name: RelationshipType
description: Information about the relationship between two Elements.
notes:
- 'Open/extensible enum: slots using this type allow any string via any_of.'
from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/spdx
rank: 1000
enum_uri: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType
permissible_values:
  affects:
    text: affects
    description: The `from` Vulnerability affects each `to` Element. The use of the
      `affects` type is constrained to `VexAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed
      relationships.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/affects
  amendedBy:
    text: amendedBy
    description: The `from` Element is amended by each `to` Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/amendedBy
  ancestorOf:
    text: ancestorOf
    description: The `from` Element is an ancestor of each `to` Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/ancestorOf
  availableFrom:
    text: availableFrom
    description: The `from` Element is available from the additional supplier described
      by each `to` Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/availableFrom
  configures:
    text: configures
    description: The `from` Element is a configuration applied to each `to` Element,
      during a LifecycleScopeType period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/configures
  contains:
    text: contains
    description: The `from` Element contains each `to` Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/contains
  coordinatedBy:
    text: coordinatedBy
    description: The `from` Vulnerability is coordinatedBy the `to` Agent(s) (vendor,
      researcher, or consumer agent).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/coordinatedBy
  copiedTo:
    text: copiedTo
    description: The `from` Element has been copied to each `to` Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/copiedTo
  delegatedTo:
    text: delegatedTo
    description: The `from` Agent is delegating an action to the Agent of the `to`
      Relationship (which must be of type invokedBy), during a LifecycleScopeType
      (e.g. the `to` invokedBy Relationship is being done on behalf of `from`).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/delegatedTo
  dependsOn:
    text: dependsOn
    description: The `from` Element depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType
      period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/dependsOn
  descendantOf:
    text: descendantOf
    description: The `from` Element is a descendant of each `to` Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/descendantOf
  describes:
    text: describes
    description: The `from` Element describes each `to` Element. To denote the root(s)
      of a tree of elements in a collection, the rootElement property should be used.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/describes
  doesNotAffect:
    text: doesNotAffect
    description: The `from` Vulnerability has no impact on each `to` Element. The
      use of the `doesNotAffect` is constrained to `VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship`
      classed relationships.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/doesNotAffect
  expandsTo:
    text: expandsTo
    description: The `from` archive expands out as an artifact described by each `to`
      Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/expandsTo
  exploitCreatedBy:
    text: exploitCreatedBy
    description: The `from` Vulnerability has had an exploit created against it by
      each `to` Agent.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/exploitCreatedBy
  fixedBy:
    text: fixedBy
    description: Designates a `from` Vulnerability has been fixed by the `to` Agent(s).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/fixedBy
  fixedIn:
    text: fixedIn
    description: A `from` Vulnerability has been fixed in each `to` Element. The use
      of the `fixedIn` type is constrained to `VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship`
      classed relationships.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/fixedIn
  foundBy:
    text: foundBy
    description: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was originally discovered by the
      `to` Agent(s).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/foundBy
  generates:
    text: generates
    description: The `from` Element generates each `to` Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/generates
  hasAddedFile:
    text: hasAddedFile
    description: Every `to` Element is a file added to the `from` Element (`from`
      hasAddedFile `to`).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasAddedFile
  hasAssessmentFor:
    text: hasAssessmentFor
    description: Relates a `from` Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security
      assessment. To be used with `VulnAssessmentRelationship` types.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasAssessmentFor
  hasAssociatedVulnerability:
    text: hasAssociatedVulnerability
    description: Used to associate a `from` Artifact with each `to` Vulnerability.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasAssociatedVulnerability
  hasConcludedLicense:
    text: hasConcludedLicense
    description: The `from` SoftwareArtifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator
      to be governed by each `to` license.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasConcludedLicense
  hasDataFile:
    text: hasDataFile
    description: 'The `from` Element treats each `to` Element as a data file. A data
      file is an artifact that stores data required or optional for the `from` Element''s
      functionality. A data file can be a database file, an index file, a log file,
      an AI model file, a calibration data file, a temporary file, a backup file,
      and more. For AI training dataset, test dataset, test artifact, configuration
      data, build input data, and build output data, please consider using the more
      specific relationship types: `trainedOn`, `testedOn`, `hasTest`, `configures`,
      `hasInput`, and `hasOutput`, respectively. This relationship does not imply
      dependency.'
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasDataFile
  hasDeclaredLicense:
    text: hasDeclaredLicense
    description: The `from` SoftwareArtifact was discovered to actually contain each
      `to` license, for example as detected by use of automated tooling.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasDeclaredLicense
  hasDeletedFile:
    text: hasDeletedFile
    description: Every `to` Element is a file deleted from the `from` Element (`from`
      hasDeletedFile `to`).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasDeletedFile
  hasDependencyManifest:
    text: hasDependencyManifest
    description: The `from` Element has manifest files that contain dependency information
      in each `to` Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasDependencyManifest
  hasDistributionArtifact:
    text: hasDistributionArtifact
    description: The `from` Element is distributed as an artifact in each `to` Element
      (e.g. an RPM or archive file).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasDistributionArtifact
  hasDocumentation:
    text: hasDocumentation
    description: The `from` Element is documented by each `to` Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasDocumentation
  hasDynamicLink:
    text: hasDynamicLink
    description: The `from` Element dynamically links in each `to` Element, during
      a LifecycleScopeType period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasDynamicLink
  hasEvidence:
    text: hasEvidence
    description: Every `to` Element is considered as evidence for the `from` Element
      (`from` hasEvidence `to`).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasEvidence
  hasExample:
    text: hasExample
    description: Every `to` Element is an example for the `from` Element (`from` hasExample
      `to`).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasExample
  hasHost:
    text: hasHost
    description: The `from` Build was run on the `to` Element during a LifecycleScopeType
      period (e.g. the host that the build runs on).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasHost
  hasInput:
    text: hasInput
    description: The `from` Build has each `to` Element as an input, during a LifecycleScopeType
      period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasInput
  hasMetadata:
    text: hasMetadata
    description: Every `to` Element is metadata about the `from` Element (`from` hasMetadata
      `to`).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasMetadata
  hasOptionalComponent:
    text: hasOptionalComponent
    description: Every `to` Element is an optional component of the `from` Element
      (`from` hasOptionalComponent `to`).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasOptionalComponent
  hasOptionalDependency:
    text: hasOptionalDependency
    description: The `from` Element optionally depends on each `to` Element, during
      a LifecycleScopeType period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasOptionalDependency
  hasOutput:
    text: hasOutput
    description: The `from` Build element generates each `to` Element as an output,
      during a LifecycleScopeType period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasOutput
  hasPrerequisite:
    text: hasPrerequisite
    description: The `from` Element has a prerequisite on each `to` Element, during
      a LifecycleScopeType period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasPrerequisite
  hasProvidedDependency:
    text: hasProvidedDependency
    description: The `from` Element has a dependency on each `to` Element, dependency
      is not in the distributed artifact, but assumed to be provided, during a LifecycleScopeType
      period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasProvidedDependency
  hasRequirement:
    text: hasRequirement
    description: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during
      a LifecycleScopeType period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasRequirement
  hasSpecification:
    text: hasSpecification
    description: Every `to` Element is a specification for the `from` Element (`from`
      hasSpecification `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasSpecification
  hasStaticLink:
    text: hasStaticLink
    description: The `from` Element statically links in each `to` Element, during
      a LifecycleScopeType period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasStaticLink
  hasTest:
    text: hasTest
    description: Every `to` Element is a test artifact for the `from` Element (`from`
      hasTest `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasTest
  hasTestCase:
    text: hasTestCase
    description: Every `to` Element is a test case for the `from` Element (`from`
      hasTestCase `to`).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasTestCase
  hasVariant:
    text: hasVariant
    description: Every `to` Element is a variant the `from` Element (`from` hasVariant
      `to`).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/hasVariant
  invokedBy:
    text: invokedBy
    description: The `from` Element was invoked by the `to` Agent, during a LifecycleScopeType
      period (for example, a Build element that describes a build step).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/invokedBy
  modifiedBy:
    text: modifiedBy
    description: The `from` Element is modified by each `to` Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/modifiedBy
  other:
    text: other
    description: Every `to` Element is related to the `from` Element where the relationship
      type is not described by any of the SPDX relationship types (this relationship
      is directionless).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/other
  packagedBy:
    text: packagedBy
    description: Every `to` Element is a packaged instance of the `from` Element (`from`
      packagedBy `to`).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/packagedBy
  patchedBy:
    text: patchedBy
    description: Every `to` Element is a patch for the `from` Element (`from` patchedBy
      `to`).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/RelationshipType/patchedBy
  publishedBy:
    text: publishedBy
    description: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was made available for public use
      or reference by each `to` Agent.

docs.text:
name: SbomType
description: 'Provides a set of values to be used to describe the common types of
  SBOMs that

  tools may create.'
from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/spdx
rank: 1000
enum_uri: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SbomType
permissible_values:
  analyzed:
    text: analyzed
    description: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables,
      packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis
      generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also
      be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SbomType/analyzed
  build:
    text: build
    description: SBOM generated as part of the process of building the software to
      create a releasable artifact (e.g., executable or package) from data such as
      source files, dependencies, built components, build process ephemeral data,
      and other SBOMs.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SbomType/build
  deployed:
    text: deployed
    description: SBOM provides an inventory of software that is present on a system.
      This may be an assembly of other SBOMs that combines analysis of configuration
      options, and examination of execution behavior in a (potentially simulated)
      deployment environment.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SbomType/deployed
  design:
    text: design
    description: SBOM of intended, planned software project or product with included
      components (some of which may not yet exist) for a new software artifact.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SbomType/design
  runtime:
    text: runtime
    description: SBOM generated through instrumenting the system running the software,
      to capture only components present in the system, as well as external call-outs
      or dynamically loaded components. In some contexts, this may also be referred
      to as an "Instrumented" or "Dynamic" SBOM.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SbomType/runtime
  source:
    text: source
    description: SBOM created directly from the development environment, source files,
      and included dependencies used to build an product artifact.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SbomType/source

name: SoftwarePurpose
description: Provides information about the primary purpose of an Element.

enum_uri: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose
permissible_values:
  application:
    text: application
    description: The Element is a software application.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/application
  archive:
    text: archive
    description: The Element is an archived collection of one or more files (.tar,
      .zip, etc.).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/archive
  bom:
    text: bom
    description: The Element is a bill of materials.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/bom
  configuration:
    text: configuration
    description: The Element is configuration data.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/configuration
  container:
    text: container
    description: The Element is a container image which can be used by a container
      runtime application.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/container
  data:
    text: data
    description: The Element is data.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/data
  device:
    text: device
    description: The Element refers to a chipset, processor, or electronic board.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/device
  deviceDriver:
    text: deviceDriver
    description: The Element represents software that controls hardware devices.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/deviceDriver
  diskImage:
    text: diskImage
    description: The Element refers to a disk image that can be written to a disk,
      booted in a VM, etc. A disk image typically contains most or all of the components
      necessary to boot, such as bootloaders, kernels, firmware, userspace, etc.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/diskImage
  documentation:
    text: documentation
    description: The Element is documentation.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/documentation
  evidence:
    text: evidence
    description: The Element is the evidence that a specification or requirement has
      been fulfilled.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/evidence
  executable:
    text: executable
    description: The Element is an Artifact that can be run on a computer.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/executable
  file:
    text: file
    description: The Element is a single file which can be independently distributed
      (configuration file, statically linked binary, Kubernetes deployment, etc.).
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/file
  filesystemImage:
    text: filesystemImage
    description: The Element is a file system image that can be written to a disk
      (or virtual) partition.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/filesystemImage
  firmware:
    text: firmware
    description: The Element provides low level control over a device's hardware.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/firmware
  framework:
    text: framework
    description: The Element is a software framework.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/framework
  install:
    text: install
    description: The Element is used to install software on disk.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/install
  library:
    text: library
    description: The Element is a software library.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/library
  manifest:
    text: manifest
    description: The Element is a software manifest.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/manifest
  model:
    text: model
    description: The Element is a machine learning or artificial intelligence model.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/model
  module:
    text: module
    description: The Element is a module of a piece of software.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/module
  operatingSystem:
    text: operatingSystem
    description: The Element is an operating system.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/operatingSystem
  other:
    text: other
    description: The Element doesn't fit into any of the other categories.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/other
  patch:
    text: patch
    description: The Element contains a set of changes to update, fix, or improve
      another Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/patch
  platform:
    text: platform
    description: The Element represents a runtime environment.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/platform
  requirement:
    text: requirement
    description: The Element provides a requirement needed as input for another Element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/requirement
  source:
    text: source
    description: The Element is a single or a collection of source files.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/source
  specification:
    text: specification
    description: The Element is a plan, guideline or strategy how to create, perform
      or analyze an application.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/specification
  test:
    text: test
    description: The Element is a test used to verify functionality on an software
      element.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Software/SoftwarePurpose/test

name: SsvcDecisionType
description: Specifies the SSVC decision type.
from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/spdx
rank: 1000
enum_uri: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Security/SsvcDecisionType
permissible_values:
  act:
    text: act
    description: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal,
      supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include
      requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing
      a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups
      would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions.
      CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Security/SsvcDecisionType/act
  attend:
    text: attend
    description: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal,
      supervisory-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance
      or information about the vulnerability, and may involve publishing a notification
      either internally and/or externally. CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities
      sooner than standard update timelines.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Security/SsvcDecisionType/attend
  track:
    text: track
    description: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization
      would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information
      becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within
      standard update timelines.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Security/SsvcDecisionType/track
  trackStar:
    text: trackStar
    description: ("Track\*" in the SSVC spec) The vulnerability contains specific
      characteristics that may require closer monitoring for changes. CISA recommends
      remediating Track\* vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Security/SsvcDecisionType/trackStar

docs.title: LinkML Source
docs.text:
name: SupportType
description: Indicates the type of support that is associated with an artifact.
from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/spdx
rank: 1000
enum_uri: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/SupportType
permissible_values:
  deployed:
    text: deployed
    description: in addition to being supported by the supplier, the software is known
      to have been deployed and is in use.  For a software as a service provider,
      this implies the software is now available as a service.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/SupportType/deployed
  development:
    text: development
    description: the artifact is in active development and is not considered ready
      for formal support from the supplier.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/SupportType/development
  endOfSupport:
    text: endOfSupport
    description: there is a defined end of support for the artifact from the supplier.  This
      may also be referred to as end of life. There is a validUntilDate that can be
      used to signal when support ends for the artifact.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/SupportType/endOfSupport
  limitedSupport:
    text: limitedSupport
    description: the artifact has been released, and there is limited support available
      from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information
      about the duration of support.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/SupportType/limitedSupport
  noAssertion:
    text: noAssertion
    description: no assertion about the type of support is made.   This is considered
      the default if no other support type is used.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/SupportType/noAssertion
  noSupport:
    text: noSupport
    description: there is no support for the artifact from the supplier, consumer
      assumes any support obligations.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/SupportType/noSupport
  support:
    text: support
    description: the artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier.   There
      is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration
      of support.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Core/SupportType/support

name: VexJustificationType
description: Specifies the VEX justification type.
from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/spdx
rank: 1000
enum_uri: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Security/VexJustificationType
permissible_values:
  componentNotPresent:
    text: componentNotPresent
    description: The software is not affected because the vulnerable component is
      not in the product.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Security/VexJustificationType/componentNotPresent
  inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist:
    text: inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist
    description: Built-in inline controls or mitigations prevent an adversary from
      leveraging the vulnerability.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Security/VexJustificationType/inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist
  vulnerableCodeCannotBeControlledByAdversary:
    text: vulnerableCodeCannotBeControlledByAdversary
    description: The vulnerable component is present, and the component contains the
      vulnerable code. However, vulnerable code is used in such a way that an attacker
      cannot mount any anticipated attack.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Security/VexJustificationType/vulnerableCodeCannotBeControlledByAdversary
  vulnerableCodeNotInExecutePath:
    text: vulnerableCodeNotInExecutePath
    description: The affected code is not reachable through the execution of the code,
      including non-anticipated states of the product.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Security/VexJustificationType/vulnerableCodeNotInExecutePath
  vulnerableCodeNotPresent:
    text: vulnerableCodeNotPresent
    description: The product is not affected because the code underlying the vulnerability
      is not present in the product.
    meaning: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.0.1/terms/Security/VexJustificationType/vulnerableCodeNotPresent
